summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Stantec Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting voting results from its annual general meeting held on May 14, 2026. The filing discloses that 73.12% of outstanding shares were represented, and all nine director nominees were elected. Shareholders also approved the reappointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers as auditor and endorsed the non-binding advisory vote on executive compensation. This is a routine management information circular and meeting results report, not a special situation triggering a special-situation category. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other extraordinary corporate event is present.
